integrity: Proof by elementary finite-state generator identities and algebraic inversion, corroborated by standalone exact-rational detailed-balance calculations. No external or independent scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary population moments are assumed; independent fresh binomial detection, time-homogeneous positive switching and recruitment, a known time lag, and finite integer population size are essential. The four moments may leave infinitely many population sizes compatible. The full time-series distribution can contain more information. Finite-sample estimation and empirical relevance are not established.
title: Exact population-size identification from imperfectly detected herding dynamics
